ABSTRACT

In the big data era, it is a great challenge to identify high-level abstract features out of a flood of sci-tech literature to achieve in-depth analysis of data. The deep learning technology has developed rapidly and achieved applications in many fields, but has rarely been utilized in the research of sci-tech literature data. This article introduced the presentation method of vector space of terminologies in sci-tech literature based on the deep learning model. It explored and adopted a deep AE model to reduce the dimensionality of input word vector feature. Also put forward is the methodology of correlation analysis of sci-tech literature based on deep learning technology. The experimental results showed that the processing of sci-tech literature data could be simplified into the computation of vectors in the multi-dimensional vector space, and the similarity in vector space could be used to represent similarity in text semantics. The correlation analysis of subject contents between sci-tech literatures of the same or different types can be made using this method.

1\. INTRODUCTION

With the rapid development of science and technology, the relationship between science and technology is getting closer and closer while their boundary is becoming more and more blurred. Relevant researches on sci-tech data, especially on sci-tech literature, are of great significance for understanding the connection between sci-tech literature, and assessing their achievements and the level of innovation. A large number of studies have shown that correlation analysis of sci-tech literature is useful for understanding sci-tech trend, measuring innovation level, etc. (Zhiyuan, Aryya, George, Michael, and Claire, 2007; Congfeng, Junming, Dongyang, Yumei, and Lifeng, 2018). The environment and the characteristics of big data make necessary and the valuable analysis on the correlations between the contents of sci-tech literature, which is also a new perspective and new application direction of the sci-tech information analysis. Taking sci-tech papers and patents for example, papers and patents are the two most important types of sci-tech Literature. Paper is an important output of the natural science and the social science research while the information contained in patents is more practical, technical and innovative than that in other sci-tech literature. The traditional academic evaluation standards based on citation methods are not in line with the needs of the big data era.

Deep learning, as a branch of machine learning and a hot field of artificial intelligence research, is intended to establish a mechanism in simulation of the neural network of human brain to analyze, learn, and interpret data such as images, sounds and texts. The concept of deep learning was put forward (Hinton and Salakhutdinov, 2006; Silver, Huang, and Maddisonc, 2016). Based on the deep belief network, the unsupervised, greedy and layer-wise training algorithm was put forward, bringing hope to solve the optimization problems related to deep structure. Later on, the deep structure of multi-layer auto-encoder was proposed. The deep machine learning methods can mainly be divided into two types: supervised learning or unsupervised learning. The learning models constructed under the frameworks of supervised and unsupervised learning are different. For examples, the convolutional neural network is a machine learning model under the framework of deep supervised learning, while the deep belief network is a machine learning model under the framework of unsupervised learning. “Deep learning” is relative to “shallow learning” methods such as support vector machine, lifting scheme and maximum entropy. The shallow learning relies on the artificial experience to extract sample characteristics, and after the model learning, it obtains the single-layer features with no hierarchical relations. While the deep learning can get hierarchical feature representation through automatic learning, using multi-layer feature transformation of input data signal to realize the change of original data sample feature representation to the new feature space, thus facilitating data classification or visualization of features. The deep network structure acquired through deep learning has the characteristics of neural networks. Thus, deep networks are actually neural networks at deep levels, namely deep neural networks (DNN). In recent years, continuous development and innovation has taken place in the deep learning field, which fuels new discoveries in its research and applications, and much progress has been achieved in model, algorithm and large-scale applications. At present, the increasing scale of sci-tech literature data poses a great challenge to the information analysis, and calls for application of the deep learning technology in the sci-tech literature data analysis.

Based on the characteristics of big data, this paper uses deep learning technology to achieve an effective dimensional reduction of the massive sci-tech data, establish a word vector representation method with contextual semantic relationship, and finally realize the content correlation analysis of the sci-tech literature. This paper will focus on the methodology of correlation analysis of sci-tech literature based on deep learning technology, so as to lay the research foundation for in-depth analysis of sci-tech literature contents in the next step. The remainder of the paper is organized as follows. The following section reviews related research. The third section and fourth section discuss the method of dimensional reduction and correlation analysis. The fifth section discusses the results of doing so. The final section concludes the paper, and proposes areas for future research.

2\. RELATED RESEARCH

2.1. Nature of Deep Learning

Deep learning is originated from the research and development of artificial neural networks. Deep learning obtains the abstract high-level features by combining low-level features in the network to identify the category or characteristics of data attributes, and find representation of useful feature of data. Hinton put forward two main views of deep learning (Han and Xu, 2016; Hou and Yang, 2017). The artificial neural network with multiple hidden layers has excellent ability of identifying features, and it can provide in-depth representation of identified feature data, which makes the final network data more accessible for classification or visualization. Although deep neural networks have some difficulty in training its own network parameters, these problems can be solved through “layer-wise initialization”, which is realized by unsupervised learning method. The nature of deep learning is feature extraction. It extracts from externally input data features at low-levels and processes them to features at advanced levels by simulating the information processing neural structure of human brain, i.e., by combination of low-level features to form more abstract high-level representation and achieve the best optimized features. A machine can understand and learn data and get the corresponding information. Traditionally, the effectiveness of machine learning depends largely on the effectiveness of data representation and input characteristics of artificial design. The role of machine learning method in this process is to optimize learning weights to ultimately output optimal learning results. Unlike traditional machine learning methods, deep learning attempts to automatically complete data representation and feature extraction, moreover, deep learning emphasizes on extraction of effective representation at different levels and from different dimensions through learning process in order to improve the ability of data interpretation at different levels of abstraction. In addition, deep learning uses a computational model composed of multiple processing layers to learn the expression of abstract data at multiple levels, and deploys the back-propagation algorithm to discover the inherent complex structure of data, and then the back-propagation algorithm directs the machine to use the expression acquired from the previous layer to change its internal parameters in the current layer (Yin and Wang, 2015; Liu, Chang, and Guo, 2016; Xi and Zhou, 2016; Sun, Lu, and Shi, 2016).

2.2. Main Models of Deep Learning

2.2.1. Deep Belief Network (DBN)

The DBN is a deep network superposed by a number of restricted Boltzmann Machines, which are a kind of double layer and undirected random neural network model with symmetric connection and no self-feedback. There is full connection between layers and no connection in the same layer. DBN learns the probability distribution of data layer by layer through the superposition of restricted Boltzmann Machines, and extracts a variety of probability features. DBN trains the entire deep belief network through unsupervised pre-training and supervised fine tuning. In the pre-training stage, unlabeled data are deployed to train restricted Boltzmann Machines in each layer separately, and the output of restricted Boltzmann Machine at the lower level is used as the input of restricted Boltzmann Machine at the upper level through a bottom-up approach. When the pre-training is completed, the network will get a good network initial value. In the fine-tuning stage, the labeled data and back-propagation algorithm fine tunes the network parameters (Chaturvedi, Tsang, and Welsch, 2016; Li, Yu, Tian, and Wang, 2017).

2.2.2. Auto-Encoder (AE)

The AE is composed of encoder and decoder. The encoder encodes the input signal and reconstructs the original signal using the encoded signal. The purpose is to make the reconstruction error minimum between the reconstructed signal and the original signal. The encoder maps the input data to the feature space, and the decoder maps the features back to the data space, thus completing the reconstruction of the input data. Typical AE evolution models are the de-noising AE and sparse AE. The de-noising AE adds noise at a certain probability distribution to the input data using AE, so that the AE neural network can learn to remove the noise, and reconstruct the input data free from interference as much as possible. The sparse AE adds constraints to the hidden layer of the prototype AE and increases the number of hidden layers, so the AE can still find the structural characteristics of the input data when the number of hidden layer neurons is very large (Hinton & Osindero, 2006).

2.2.3. Convolutional Neural Network (CNN)

The CNN is a kind of feed-forward multilayer neural network with local connection and weight sharing. Its main structure includes the convolution part and the whole connection part. The convolution part is composed of the convolution layer, the activation layer and the lower sampling layer, and extracts features through superposition. The whole connection part connects feature extraction, outputs computation loss and performs function of recognition and classification. Each computational layer of the network consists of multiple feature maps, and each feature map is a plane, the weights of all the neurons in the plane are equal, thus reducing the number of free parameters in the network, ameliorating the complexity of parameter selection in the network, and improving the generalization ability of the network. Each convolution layer in the CNN is followed by a computational layer which is used to compute the local average and the secondary extraction. The special double feature extraction reduces the feature resolution. The training of CNN adopts the supervised training method. First, it is in a way of forward propagation when the input is changed to output through CNN. Then the output is compared with the label, and the error is transmitted to each node in a backward propagation way. The formula is updated according to the weight value, and the corresponding convolution kernel weight value is also updated (Poria, Cambria, and Gelbukh, 2016).

2.2.4. Recurrent Neural Network (RNN)

The RNN is a special forward propagation neural network, the specialty of which lies in its hidden layer of the model with self-connection and mutual connection, which transmits delayed signals through a recurrence matrix, so that the RNN obtains short-term memory properties. The output of each neuron of the RNN is not only transmitted to the upper layer, but also transmitted directly to the next sequence, which in fact increases the connection between each neuron of the hidden layer. In this way, the historical information of the neurons will be kept with the passage of time. The RNN solves the setback of the deep neural network, i.e., the incapability to establish model for the changes in time sequence even though it has the ability to fit complex functions. After this treatment, the deep learning can adapt to the characteristics of time series inherent to natural language and speech data (Alexey, Alois, and Hans, 2012).

2.3. Open-Source Framework Supporting Deep Learning and Tool

Deep learning, as a machine learning method based on identifying the representation of data, has the advantage to replace manual feature acquisition with unsupervised or semi-supervised feature learning and multi-layer feature extraction algorithms. Companies such as Google, Facebook and Microsoft support some open source deep learning frameworks for deep learning. At present, the deep learning frameworks used by researchers include Theano, TensorFlow, Keras, Caffe, and so on. These deep learning frameworks have been applied in computer visualization, speech recognition, natural language processing and bioinformatics with good results (Li, Xie, and Yi, 2017). In this paper, our work mainly uses Keras framework, so we mainly introduce the Keras framework in the following.

2.3.1. Keras

Some researchers subsequently developed the Keras, a deep learning framework based on Theano. It uses Python language, and it aims to build a simple and highly modular neural network library, which targets at rapid conversion of research ideas into prototype framework of deep learning experiments, and avoids the loss of validation of creativity arising from the difficulty of experiments. Keras has excellent extensibility and can run on CPU and GPU platforms. Keras is built on Theano library, nevertheless, it supports another function library. Keras has the following characteristics. The computation graphs of Theano and TensorFlow support more general computations, while Keras excels in deep learning. It provides a convenient API. Users only need to splice the advanced modules together to design a neural network. It supports the convolution network and recurrent network, cascaded models or any model of graph structure. It doesn’t need any code changes switching from computing on CPU to GPU acceleration, thus reducing the complexity of programming and lowering programming overhead. All the modules of Keras are simple, easy to understand, fully configurable and pluggable with basically no use restrictions, and modules of neural network, loss function, optimizer, initialization, activation and regularization can mix freely. The model is more complex, but the advantage of using Keras is greater. Keras can’t directly use multiple GPUs, so it is slower in speed when processing large-scale data than other frameworks that support multiple GPU and distribution.

Traditionally One-hot representation method is used for word vector representation, which represents every word into a long word vector with word vector values of either 0 or 1, mostly 0, so that the word vector dimension is high and sparse (Ma,2016). The Distributed Representation method of word vector is an improvement to the traditional One-hot representation method, the main idea of which is to obtain the distributed representation feature of a word by training the neural network language model, i.e., representing a word in the text by a continuous real number vector, and measuring the semantic similarity between words by the distance between the words. The word vectors acquired by distributed representation can abstractly express the semantic meaning of words, that is, semantically similar words are similar in vector space. Therefore, word representation through word vector distributed representation method can express the features of words as much as possible, thus the model can better learn the advanced features of the represented words. The open source tool of Google--Word2vec, as an efficient tool for characterizing words as real number valued vector, uses distributed representation method to represent word vectors.

2.3.2. Word2vec

Word2vec is an efficient tool to represent words into real-value vectors that have been opened source by Google Company in 2013.The word vectors outputted by Word2vec can be used in many natural language processing related tasks, such as word clustering, synonyms analysis, sentiment analysis and so on. If we take words as features, then Word2vec can map features into multidimensional vector spaces, which endows text data with representation at deeper level. Word2vec uses the distributed representation method for word vectors representation. Distributed representation was first put forward by Hinton in 1986, the basic idea is to map each word into K dimensional real-value vector through training, and the distance between the words is used to determine the semantic similarity between them. It uses a three-layer neural network, namely, the input layer, hidden layer and output layer. One of the core technologies is Huffman encoding based on word frequency, which enables words with similar word frequency to have basically identical contents activated in the hidden layer, the higher frequency the words have, the less hidden layers activated, thus effectively reducing the computational complexity. The three-layer neural network itself models the language model, but it also gets a representation of the word in the vector space. Compared with the classical process of Latent Semantic Analysis (LSI) and Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), Word2vec uses the word context, so that the semantic information is more abundant. Word2vec can express a word into vector form quickly and effectively through the optimized training mode for any given corpus. Word2vec contains two training models, namely, CBOW (as shown in Figure 1) and Skip-gram (as shown in Figure 2).

| Figure 1. Schematic of CBOW model |
| --- |
| ![Figure978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.f01](i/ch085.f01.png) |
| --- |

| Figure 2. Schematic of skip-gram model |
| --- |
| ![Figure978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.f02](i/ch085.f02.png) |
| --- |

As can be seen from Figure 1 and Figure 2, both the CBOW and Skip-gram models contain input layer, projection layer, and output layer. The CBOW model predicts the current word through the context, assuming that the current word is w(t), the size of the context window is k, the inputs of the model, w(t-k), and w(t-k+1),...,w(t+k-1), w(t+k), represent the word vectors of the context words related to the current word. Add up the inputs to get the value of the projection layer. The training objective of the output layer is to maximize the probability of correct words by processing the context words, that is, the word vector is acquired through processing the context. The specific form is a binary tree which takes the word frequency of the words in the corpus as weight structure. The leaf nodes correspond to all the words in the vocabulary. Suppose the leaf node is N, then the non-leaf node is N-1. Both the leaf and non-leaf nodes correspond to a vector. The vector corresponding to the leaf node is the word vector, and the vector corresponding to the non-leaf node is an auxiliary vector. The Skip-gram model predicts its context of the current word, and the model’s input is the word vector of the current word w(t). The projection layer is the identical projection, and the corresponding form of the output layer is also a binary tree.

2.4. Method of Correlation Analysis of Sci-Tech Literature

The correlation analysis of sci-tech literature is mainly used to analyze the link relations between sci-tech literature, which are achieved through the correlation between their characteristic items. There are mainly two ways: one is to use the external characteristics of literature, including citations, authors, inventors or institutions of patents and other related information to determine the relation, the other is the use of the content characteristics of literature, typically the keywords to establish relations:

*   1\. The method based on citation analysis: The method based on citation analysis is to construct the relation through the mutual reference relations between patents and papers, and analyze the mutual relationship. There is mainly the method of the paper citation analysis of patents and the method of patent citation analysis of paper. The paper citation analysis method of patent used to study “science-technology relation” was first put forward in 1983(Carpenter and Narin,1983) and Narin who used this method to identify 12 science-dependent technical areas out of 24 areas. By comparing with the results of manual evaluation, they proved the validity of using patent citation analysis to analyze the sci-tech literature relation. In 2002, Verbeek et al. put forward the framework model of using non-patent citation to carry out sci-tech correlation analysis (Verbeek, Debackere, Luwel, Andries, Zimmermann, and Deleus,2002), and many subsequent studies were carried out on the basis of this model. In the research of patent citation analysis of paper, Yang Zuguo et al. analyzed the citation of Chinese patents by SCI, and found that the patents in chemical and metallurgical fields were cited most frequently and the cited patents were mainly applied by colleges, universities and the institutes of Chinese Academy of Sciences (Yang, Chen, and Zhu, 1999). Glänzel and Meyer analyzed the science-technology relation from the perspectives of the subject distribution of papers that cited patent literature, the country distribution of the inventors of highly cited patents and the category distribution of patents related to the subjects of various papers (Glänzel and Meyer, 2003). Some scholars combined the above two methods to reveal the two-way correlation between science and technology knowledge. Li (2013) constructed the feedback coefficient, designed the fusion algorithm of the scientific correlation metrics and the feedback coefficient, and fulfilled the improvement of scientific correlation measurement index based on the science and technology reciprocal feed precession theory. Huang, Yang,and Chen (2015) studied the two-way citation of papers and patents in the fuel cell field, and found that the relation between science and technology in this field was becoming closer, and papers tended to refer to newer patents;
*   2\. The method based on content analysis: This method analyzes the relation between patents and papers based on their contents. The general steps are: extracting text features from patents and papers, representing features of patents and papers, clustering patents and papers respectively, extracting category subjects, comparing the subject categories of patents and paper for the purpose of technical opportunity discovery, and studying frontiers discovery. Li (2010) attempted to use the controlled word fields such as subject indexing terms and registry number of papers and patents in abstract database and the words in the free text fields such as title, abstract, author and keywords to reveal the correlation between papers and patents. Wang et al. also used the vector space model to express the content of patents and papers, and then used the ORCLUS algorithm to analyze and identify the subjects of papers and patents through dimensionality reduction and clustering, in order to find the technology opportunities from the comparison of different subjects. Huang, Wang, and Li (2016) extracted the Subject-Action-Object (SAO) structure of titles and abstracts, computed the similarity of SAO results to get the similarity between papers and patents, and summarized clustered subjects to discover the potential opportunity based on the analysis of multidimensional scale clustering in combination with expert opinions. Document representation models such as LSA, LDA and others document representation models have been applied to correlation research and analysis of patents and papers (Sheth, Aleman-Meza, Arpinar, Bertram, Warke, Ramakrishanan, Halaschek, Anyanwu, Avant, and Arpinar,2005; Junsheng, Yunchuan, and Changqing, 2017).

Some scholars have tried to combine the citation and content analysis methods to analyze the relevance of patents with papers. For example, Shibata, Kajikawa, and Sakata (2011) constructed separate citation networks for papers and patents respectively based on citation information, and classified the networks by use of the topological clustering algorithm, then extracted nouns and noun phrases from each class and represent the classes as vectors, and finally calculate the topic similarity between the papers and patents. In summary, it can be found that the major defect of the citation analysis method is that the motivation of the patent citation is not clear, and the citation passages are not standardized, which makes it difficult to extract phrases accurately. Most of researches based on citation analysis only include quantitative statistics and analysis, without in-depth analysis from the content and topic perspectives. In addition, as Chinese sci-tech patents contain no citation passages, the citation-based analysis method is not suitable for link analysis between Chinese papers and patents. The content-based analysis method and the mixed method mainly study topic similarity to find the linkage in content between sci-tech papers and patents. But in absence of semantic analysis, the accuracy of topic clustering is limited given the massive scale of big data.

In the big data era, with the growing amount of sci-tech literature, the correlation analysis between the same and different types of sci-tech literature data has become increasingly important for the analysis and application of scientific literature information (Huimin and Sudha, 2004; Peng, Junsheng, Changqing, and Wen, 2016; Wen, Hongjiao, and Junsheng, 2017; Junsheng, Kun, and Changqing, 2018). This paper proposes to analyze the subject similarity between the single type and the two types of sci-tech literature data based on the vector representation and dimensionality reduction method of sci-tech literature words mentioned above and takes Chinese scientific and technical paper and patent data as an example, to achieve the correlation analysis between the same type and different types of sci-tech literature data.

3\. METHOD OF DIMENSIONAL REDUCTION OF MULTIDIMENSIONAL VECTOR FEATURES BASED ON DEEP LEARNING MODEL

The deep learning model that takes the AE as the core is called deep AE. The deep AE is a deep learning model stacked by multi-layer AEs, which has one input layer, one output layer and at least 3 hidden layers. Theoretically speaking, the number of nodes in the input layer should be the same as the number of dimensions of the original input data, the number of nodes in the hidden layer should be less than the number of nodes in the input layer, the number of nodes in the latter hidden layer should be less than that in the previous hidden layer, and the number of nodes in the final output layer should be the smallest. The structure of deep AE is shown in Figure 3.

| Figure 3. Structure of deep AE |
| --- |
| ![Figure978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.f03](i/ch085.f03.png) |
| --- |

The deep AE model can realize dimensionality reduction and feature reconstruction of the original input data, and each layer is the reconstruction expression of the previous layer, and the output model of final output layer expresses the characteristics of original input data in low dimensional and abstract manner. The principle of dimensionality reduction, feature expression and reconstruction of original input data by the model is as follows: Assuming that the original data of input vector n is represented as x\= {x[1],x[2],…,x[t]}, the vector mapped to the hidden layer is represented as y= {y[1],y[2],…,y[m]}, the mapping function of mapping the original input data from input layer to the hidden layer (the encoding process of the original input data) is represented as follow:

y = f[θ](x) (1)

where the coding parameter θ={W,b}. W is the weight matrix, and b is the offset vector. f[θ](x) is the activation function of the decoder. A classical mainstream activation function is sigmoid function, with the expression as follow:

![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m01](i/ch085.m01.svg) (2)

Since the sigmoid function may incur problems of slow convergence speed and disappearance of gradient in the training process, there have appeared some new activation functions in recent years, such as the representative softplus function and Rectified Linear Units (ReLU) function. The expression of the softplus function is as follow:

f(x) = ln(1+e^x) (3)

The expression of ReLU function is as follow:

f(x) = max(0,x) (4)

The decoder function remaps the abstract expression of original input data in the hidden layer back to the output layer, and the resulting reconstruction is represented as z. The mapping function of the mapping process can be represented as follow:

![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m02](i/ch085.m02.svg) (5)

where ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m03](i/ch085.m03.svg) is the activation function of decoder, the decoding parameter is ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m04](i/ch085.m04.svg), ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m05](i/ch085.m05.svg) is the transposition of W, namely ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m06](i/ch085.m06.svg), ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m07](i/ch085.m07.svg) is the offset vector. In the training process of AE, it needs to optimize the parameter θ and ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m08](i/ch085.m08.svg), the purpose of optimization is to make the error between the output data re-constructed from the decoder and the original input data minimum, i.e. to minimize the losses caused by the reconstruction, and to obtain the optimal parameters ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m09](i/ch085.m09.svg) and ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m10](i/ch085.m10.svg). The target function is the minimized reconstructed error function (loss function), which can be represented as:

![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m11](i/ch085.m11.svg) (6)

where L is the reconstructed error function (loss function), and the cross entropy loss function is adopted here, with the representation as follow:

![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m12](i/ch085.m12.svg) (7)

In obtaining the optimal parameters ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m13](i/ch085.m13.svg) and ![Mathtype978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.m14](i/ch085.m14.svg), which is the same as obtaining the optimal value of weight W and offset vector b, certain optimization methods should be adopted to optimize the parameters,and the classical optimization method is the Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). In addition, there are several new optimization methods, such as the Adagrad method (Hinton and Osindero,2006) and the Adam method (Qu,Du,and Di,2014;Wang,Fang,and Chang,2015). The Adagrad method can adaptively adjust the learning rate in the process of optimization. Whereas the Adam method, in addition to adaptively adjusting the learning rate, also increases the momentum item, so that the parameter can move towards the expected direction of adjustment as much as possible.

4\. METHOD OF CORRELATION ANALYSIS OF SCI-TECH LITERATURE BASED ON SCI-TECH LITERATURE TERMINOLOGIES

4.1. Acquisition of Keyword Vectors in Different Types of Sci-Tech Literature

As far as the sci-tech journal paper data are concerned, the keywords given by authors have relatively high accuracy and can well reflect subject contents of papers, so the content analysis of sci-tech journal paper takes keywords as analysis objects. However, the patent literature data does not have clearly specified keywords, so it is not feasible to take the specified keywords as the analysis objects. Instead, this paper uses the automatic keyword extraction method to analyze the subjects of sci-tech journal papers and patent literature. At the same time, in order to reduce the number of subsequent word vectors and obtain words that best express subjects of technical papers and patents, this research uses part-of-speech tagging results and TF-IDF value of words to extract keywords from documents, then filters the notional words by setting the threshold, and finally gets a set of keywords as the analysis objects of technical papers and patents. The sci-tech words representation and dimensionality reduction method based on the foregoing deep learning technology is adopted, namely, the scientific papers and patents are used as input, the CBOW model of Word2vec is used to generate a high dimensional vector for each word in the intersection of two documents, and then the extraction of the word vector of keywords for the subsequent processing.

4.2. Clustering of Keyword Vectors in Sci-Tech Literature

Considering the basis to establish relation between sci-tech journal paper and patent literature is their relevance in research subjects, it is necessary to carry out clustering analysis after extracting keyword vectors to acquire research subjects of sci-tech journal paper and patent literature. This paper adopts the X-means clustering algorithm for the extraction of keyword vectors in scientific literature. X-means algorithm has made improvement on the traditional K-means clustering algorithm, in the initial computation of the algorithm. There is no need to specify the number of clusters, K, and it only needs to specify a value range of K. The algorithm will find an optimal number of clusters in this range to achieve clustering division. The workflow of X-means clustering algorithm is evaluated by the Bayesian Information Criterion (BIC) to iteratively adjust the number of clusters. After the clustering of keyword vectors, it is necessary to compute the weights of all keywords in subject categories, and then change subject categories into vectors represented by keywords and their weights. The specific method is to compute the distance between each keyword to its cluster center and normalize it, and then use the normalized result as the weight of each keyword.

4.3. Compute the Semantic Similarity between Subjects of Different Types of Sci-Tech Literature

The traditional computation methods of vectors similarity includes angle cosine method, similarity coefficient method, Jaccard coefficient method and Dice coefficient method. The similarity computation method used in this paper is the angle cosine method. However, the common angle cosine method does not take into account the semantics of words and the similarity between words, and only uses the same lexical terms as the same dimension for computation. There has always been the issue of synonym and polysemy in text similarity computation, and the great differences between scientific and technical papers and patent literature in such aspects as writing purpose, writing requirements and terminology expression etc., these problems would be more prominent when computing their similarity. Therefore, this article treats two-word items with similarity greater than the threshold value as the same dimension for computation. In addition, during the computation of the similarity between subject categories of scientific journal papers and patents, only the similarity of subject categories in adjacent years is computed to analyze the evolution trend of subject categories of scientific and technical papers and patents with time. However, considering the possibility of time lag to the mutual influence of patent and journal literature, the paper doesn’t consider the time factor in computing the similarity between the scientific and technical paper and patent subject category.For example, for subject categories T[1] and T[2], assuming that T[1] includes the keyword {W[11], W[12], …, W[1m]}, T[2] includes the keyword {W[21], W[22],…, W[2n]}, and m > n. The angle cosine method is used to compute the semantic similarity of keyword vectors, and a keyword similarity matrix of m\*n is constructed. The row i and column j element Sij of the matrix is the similarity of W[1i] and W[2j]. When computing the similarity between the subject category T[1] and the subject category T[2], we need to find the maximum value Max in the matrix element and the weight W[1p] and W[2q] of its corresponding words in each subject category vector. W[1p], W[2q] and Max are added to the vector W[T1], W[T2] and V[sim], and the element in row p and column q is removed from the matrix. Repeat the above steps until the matrix is empty or the Max value is less than the similarity threshold.Assuming that the word pair with similarity greater than the threshold value is r, and the weights of remaining m-r words in T[1] and the remaining n-r words in T[2] are added to the W[T1] and W[T2] respectively, zero(the number of zero is m-n)is added in W[T2] and zero(the number of zero is m-r) is added in Vsim. The semantic similarity of the subject category T[1] and subject category T[2] is then computed according to the following formula:

5\. EXPERIMENT AND ANALYSIS

The analysis of sci-tech literature, especially the in-depth processing and analysis based on the content of sci-tech literature, can’t be done without the identification and representation of sci-tech words in sci-tech literature. Therefore, this paper adopts the deep learning technology for dimensionality reduction of sci-tech literature, and uses Word2vec to characterize the words in sci-tech literature into word vectors. Then the paper realizes the correlation analysis of subject contents between sci-tech literatures of the same or different types.

The experimental data used by this article are the Chinese patent data and journal paper data in the field of new energy vehicle. The patent data includes 91934 pieces of patent data, and the journal paper data includes 31026 pieces of paper abstract data. The CBOW model is used to train the science and technology words vector, the dimension of the word vector is set to 100, and the size of the word vector text window is set to 5. The trained word vector file is shown in Figure 4.

| Figure 4. Local diagram of some word vector files acquired through Word2vec training (Feature dimension: 100-dimension) |
| --- |
| ![Figure978-1-7998-0414-7.ch085.f04](i/ch085.f04.png) |
| --- |

This paper uses the deep AE model described above to reduce the dimensionality of the input word vector feature, and builds a deep AE model with three hidden layers. For each layer, the number of nodes should be determined according to the actual situation. The number of input layer nodes should be consistent with the number of input vector dimension, namely 100-dimension; and the number of nodes in hidden layer should be less than the number of nodes in the previous layer theoretically, which is set to 50, 25 and 10 respectively in this paper. The number of nodes in the output layer should be the number of the feature dimension of the final compression, which is set to 5 in this paper. In other words, the deep AE model extracts 100-dimension features through the compression of three layers of hidden layer, and finally gets 5-dimension features. Since the deep AE is a nonlinear data dimension reduction, the nonlinear activation function used in the node is sigmoid function, and the optimization algorithm is Stochastic Gradient Descent (SGD). The loss function is cross entropy function. When the value of loss function is less than a certain threshold value or the training iteration number reaches a certain threshold, the training ends. The low dimensional feature of the final output layer can be used as the advanced abstract expression of the word vector feature of the original input. Some low dimensional features are shown in Figure 5.

In order to verify the rationality of the correlation analysis methods of different types of sci-tech literature, this section selects the Chinese technical journals and patent literature in the field of new energy vehicle for empirical study, the experimental data includes 26,086 scientific and technical journal papers and 17,046 patents, covering a time span of 5 years from 2009 to 2013. The data set is used to carry out the empirical study of the correlation analysis method of sci-tech journal papers and patent literature. Firstly, based on the part-of-speech tagging results, the words tagged as nouns, verbs and adjectives are extracted from the patent literature and journal papers to be used as the candidate words, then the classical TF-IDF formula is used to compute the value of TF-IDF of all candidate words and make sequence, the words with value higher than the set thresholds are extracted as keywords. The top 10 keywords in each year extracted from sci-tech journal papers and patents are listed in Table 1. As can be seen from Table 1, in the five years from 2009 to 2013, the keywords at the top of the list of the journal papers are relatively fixed, and the keywords “matlab”, “model”, “simulation” and “simulink” are ranked high in five years. On the contrary, the keywords of patent literature are scattered, and the top 10 keywords are changed every year, showing that the novelty and creative requirements of patent applications make keywords of patents more dispersed and changeable than those of papers.

In this paper, the word vector training of keywords is achieved with the open source Word2vec tool. After acquiring word vectors of keywords, the experiment clusters keyword vectors of papers and patents respectively by means of the X-means clustering algorithm in the Weka data mining tool platform, and sets the minimum number of clusters to 3 and maximum number to 15. Then, the experiment computes the weight of each keyword in its clustering, and transforms each subject category that has been clustered into a vector represented by the keyword and its weight.

For any two subject categories, the keyword vector is used to compute the similarity of their keywords, and to form the semantic similarity matrix, and then the experiment computes the semantic similarity of the two categories using the previously mentioned method. In order to show the subject evolution trend, the patent evolution trend and the correlation between papers and patents in the sci-tech journal papers in the subsequent maps, all subject categories are ranked according to the similarity value, and the top 20 subjects in similarity of paper subject category in adjacent years, the top 20 subjects in similarity of patent subject category in adjacent years and the top 20 subjects in similarity of journal papers and patent literature in all years are extracted, the specific results are listed in Table 2, Table 3, and Table 4.

Based on the above computation, this paper attempts to use the combination of time and scale to display the subject of papers and patents and the related correlation information of each sub-period in maps. 1)Subject: it refers to the paper/patent subject in each sub-period through a column of circles. The size of the circle reflects the scale of each subject, that is, the larger the size of the circle, the higher the average word frequency of the words contained in the subject, and the larger the subject scale. 2)Relevance of the subject: in order to show the trend of subjects over time, the subjects of high similarity are connected, and the higher the similarity, the thicker the connection line. At the same time, the similarity threshold is set to 0.5, the line among the subject categories with similarity higher than 0.5 is solid line, and the line among the subject categories with similarity less than 0.5 is dotted line. The paper believes that the evolution of subjects of sci-tech journal papers and patents are continuous in time, and the correlation and evolution between paper and patent subjects may have a certain time difference, so the top 20 subjects in similarity of paper subject category in adjacent years, the top 20 subjects in similarity of patent subject category in adjacent years and the top 20 subjects in similarity of journal papers and patent literature in all years are selected, and these subjects are connected in lines. The starting point of the line is the subject category of the earlier time and the end point is the subject category of the later time, and finally the thematic relational evolution graph is formed. The thematic evolution graph of the new energy vehicle field during 2009-2013 (see Figure 6) is drawn according to the time series, and contains scientific journal papers and patent literature. Each column of spheres represents paper and patent subjects of a given year, and the upper part shows paper subjects, and the lower part shows patent subjects. The subject category pairs of papers in adjacent years. The subject category pairs of patents in adjacent years and the paper-parent subject category in all years that ranked top 20 in similarity are connected. The starting point of the line is the subject category of earlier time and the end point is the subject category of later time. If the two subject categories are of the same year, then a two-way arrow is used to connect them. Table 5 shows the evolution path of subjects in Sci-Tech journal papers.

*   1\. The sci-tech research in the field of new energy vehicle remained relatively stable between 2009 and 2013. Little change has taken place in the number of subjects, and no subjects appear or disappeared at large-scale each year. It can be found from the subject categories of sci-tech papers in adjacent years ranking top 10 in similarity that there are 3 complete subject evolution paths, and the specific path information and the labels of each subject are shown in Table 4. At the same time, there are two incomplete evolution paths, 2010-t8→2011-t4→2012-t5→2013-t7 and 2010-t6→2011-t9→2012-t1; 
    *   2.Compared with the similarity between the subjects of papers of different sub periods, the similarity between patent subjects is much smaller, and there are only 11 pairs of patent titles with correlation degree above 50%. This is determined by the characteristics of patents themselves: patents emphasize technical innovation and avoidance of repetition. At the same time, compared to scientific research, technical innovation in the field of new energy vehicle is more active, the number of subjects has gradually increased, and subjects in different sub-periods has certain degrees of differentiation and integration. For example, the subject t2 in 2011 is differentiated into subjects t1 and t2 in 2012, the subject t5 was differentiated into t3 and t4, the subject t2 in 2012 is differentiated into the subjects t7, t8 and t9 in 2013, and the subject t6 in 2013;
    *   3.The correlation in subjects of sci-tech papers and patents in the field of new energy vehicle is low. There are only 12 pairs of scientific and technical papers and patents with correlation degree more than 50%, and the paper and patent subjects with correlation degree of more than 30% only accounted 13.6% of all paper and patent subjects, showing that the correlation between the papers and journals in the new energy vehicle industry is low, which is consistent with the previous research results, indicating the effectiveness of the method put forward in this paper.

In addition, the experimental results also shows that there is a reciprocal relation between sci-tech papers and patents: for example, the patent subject t3 in 2009 has affected the paper subjects t4 in 2010, t6 in 2011 and t2 in 2013; the paper subjects t6 in 2009, t4 in 2010, t6 in 2011 and t7 in 2012 has affected the patent subject t3 in 2013, which showed that the research results of sci-tech papers provided support for patents and the patents also inspired the paper writers likewise.The sci-tech research provides a source of knowledge for technological progress, and conversely, new technological inventions can serve as a source of inspiration for sci-tech research and exploration of new research areas, both of them achieved precession in the process of knowledge transfer and feedback.

6\. DISCUSSION

The sci-tech information analysis should be optimized by incorporating advanced technics, such as big data analysis methods and technologies, so as to effectively analyze and acquire sci-tech information from big data (Batini, Rula, Scannapieco, and Viscusi, 2015). The integration of multidisciplinary methods and technologies will inevitably bring about an innovation and development of information analysis methods and theories. This paper contains in-depth data content mining and analysis specific to scientific and technological data (such as papers and patents) and especially exploratory work by reference to deep learning technologies, in which deep learning technologies are used in the correlation analysis of sci-tech data, and ideal research results are achieved:

*   1\. The analysis of scientific literature, especially the deep processing and analysis based on the content of sci-tech literature cannot be separated from the representation of sci-tech literature, that is, the expression of sci-tech terminology. The natural language processing technology is used to mainly realize the tasks such as part-of-speech tagging, named entity recognition, phrase recognition, and semantic role labeling of sci-tech terms in the sci-tech literature. As the natural language has recursive feature, that is, sentences in any language are recursive combinations of words and phrases, it is a trend to introduce the recurrent neural network into the natural language processing. Since 2010, Google have been engaged in the research in this field and proposed the recurrent neural network language model (RNNLM), which enables the improvement of the training speed and accuracy of language models. One of the important applications of the deep learning technology in the sci-tech literature is the multidimensional vector representation of sci-tech terminology to obtain more contextual semantic information and achieve the effective analysis of the content of sci-tech literature. In this paper, the CBOW model is used for training about sci-tech terminology vectors to realize the vector representation of sci-tech literature;
*   2\. From the results of experiments, we can find: 1) The key point and difficulty in use of the auto-encoder model is that the main components representing the input data must be identified accurately to the greatest extent possible in various stages of dimensionality reduction, feature expression and reconstruction in order to minimize errors in the reproduction of input data. Each layer of the training depth auto-encoder adopts the unsupervised method. The weights of each layer of training are used to initialize the final depth network weight and then the entire network is fine-tuned by use of tagged word data to optimize the parameters obtained from the unsupervised training; 2) The in-depth auto-encoder can reduce the data dimension of high-dimensional technology words to obtain low-dimensional feature vectors and realize distributed feature representation. In this process, the values of different hidden layers are obtained through parameter adjustment by the model training and each hidden layer represents an expression of raw data; 
    *   3.The deep learning technology has been well applied in many fields but seldom applied in researches on the big data of sci-tech literature. In fact, we should draw upon the rationality of deep learning in the in-depth analysis of the contents of sci-tech literature and integrate various sci-tech literature contents to achieve effective expression of the contents of the sci-tech literature, which will be one of the directions of research on the sci-tech information in the future. The main problems of the deep learning technology are as follows: 1) The researches on deep learning are mostly based on experimental training and there are few studies on its internal principles and the nature of learning. Most of the current researches focus on the network architecture, parameter selection, etc. and the result of deep learning is a locally optimal solution rather than a globally optimal solution. Therefore, there is still room for further improvement and more complete and in-depth theories are needed to support its development; 2) The main application of deep learning is still in the supervised learning. Even in the unsupervised learning, supervised fine-tuning is required after the unsupervised pre-training, so it is not completely unsupervised learning in a sense. As most of data in actual researches are unlabeled data, how to achieve unsupervised learning in the full sense is still the focus and difficulty of the research; 3) Deep learning at this stage focus more on data processing and less on intellectual development, such as memory ability and logical reasoning ability. In the face of complex real-world tasks, it's necessary to predict and store the content containing the information sequence, which is also a research direction for deep learning in the future. Therefore, the deep learning technology is of great significance for the analysis of sci-tech literature data and the acquisition of sci-tech information although it is still necessary to make break-through in such difficult problems.

7\. CONCLUSION

In summary, the deep learning technology can be used to realize the multi-dimensional representation of the vector space of sci-tech words and thereby achieve the representation of the sci-tech literature. The in-depth model with an auto-encoder can effectively reduce the vector dimension of sci-tech words, which will help to effectively realize the representation of the sci-tech literature and to achieve the efficiency of analysis and comparison of different types of sci-tech literature. The backdrop of big data eradetermines that the correlation analysis of sci-tech literature data is necessary and valuable. The correlation analysis of sci-tech literature data also provides a new perspective and new application direction of sci-tech information analysis methods. The correlation analysis of sci-tech literature data plays an important role in understanding the linkages between science and technology, examining commercialization of scientific and technological achievements and monitoring the level of innovation. Sci-tech journals and patents are the two most important types of sci-tech literature, whereas the sci-tech journals focus on the academic literature, acting as important embodiment of research outputs in natural sciences and social sciences; patents focus on practicality, technology and innovation. Therefore, the study of the correlation between them can examine the effect and extent of the transformation of scientific and technological research achievements in a sense. Targeting at the two types of data of sci-tech journals and patents, this paper makes the realization of effective vector representation and dimensionality reduction of sci-tech literature data using deep learning technology, establishes the representation method of sci-tech literature vector words with semantic context relations, and performs subject correlation analysis of sci-tech literature data content-based on this. Through experiments, we can find that: deep learning technology can realize multi-dimensional representation of the vector space of words of science and technology literature, and the deep model of AE can effectively reduce the dimensionality of vector words of science and technology literature. Sci-tech literature data representation and dimensionality reduction helps to realize the sci-tech literature representation and correlation analysis of sci-tech literature data contents. The sci-tech literature data is tremendous, so the sci-tech data mining is an emerging interdisciplinary subject involving a wide range of topics and is technically challenging. It calls for comprehensive cooperation between researchers in computer sciences, statistics and information science. It can be foreseen that data analysis technology has broad application prospects in the field of science and technology study.

# Chapter 86

*   Kaiyan Han  
    Jiujiang University, China
*   Qin Wang  
    Jiujiang University, China

ABSTRACT

In the era of big data, intelligent sports venues have a practical significance to provide personalized service for users and build up a platform for stadium management. This article proposes a new parallel big data promotion algorithm based on the latest achievements of big data analysis. The proposed algorithm calculates the optimal value by using the observed variables Y, the hidden variable data Z, the joint distribution P (Y, Z | θ) and distribution conditions P (Z | Y | θ). The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has higher accuracy of big data analysis, and can serve the intelligent sports venues better.

1\. INTRODUCTION

Depth learning is a method of machine learning based on data representation learning. Depth learning combines low-level features to form more abstract high-level, which denotes class, or feature of a property so as to discover a distributed representation of data (Haytham, Fayek & Lawrence, 2017). Observations can be represented in a variety of ways, such as the vector of each pixel's intensity value, or more abstractly, into a series of edges, regions of a particular shape, et al. Depth learning is a new field of machine learning research. Its motivation is to build and simulate neural networks for human brain analysis and learning. It simulates the mechanism of the human brain to interpret data (Marta et al., 2017). Depth machine learning methods include supervised learning and unsupervised learning (Oscar et al., 2017). The learning models built under different learning frameworks are different. How to use depth learning technology to help the media to improve the quality of the content, click through rate and how to help the new media content operation is the focus of future research.

Deep learning is a new machine learning field in the study of the motivation is to establish and simulate the human brain to analyze neural network learning mechanism, it imitates human brain to interpret the data, such as image, sound and text (Guoqiang, LiNa, Xiao, & Junyu, 2017). The core idea of deep learning are as follows: (1) unsupervised learning for each layer of the pre-train network;(2)unsupervised learning training only with a layer of the time, the training as a result of its high level of input; (3)the supervision method from top to bottom to adjust all layers. A deep learning structure is usually a multilayer perception containing multiple hidden layers (Junliang, Kai, Weiming, Chunfeng, & Haibin, 2017). Figure 1 shows a depth learning model containing multiple hidden layers.

| Figure 1. A depth learning model containing multiple hidden layers |

| --- |

Social media are computer-mediated technologies that facilitate the creation and sharing of information, ideas, career interests and other forms of expression via virtual communities and networks. Social media use web-based technologies, desktop computers and mobile technologies (e.g., smart phones and tablet computers) to create highly interactive platforms through which individuals, communities and organizations can share, co-create, discuss, and modify user-generated content or pre-made content posted online. They introduce substantial and pervasive changes to communication between businesses, organizations, communities and individuals (Junliang, 2017). Social media changes the way individuals and large organizations communicate. These changes are the focus of the emerging field of techno-self studies. Social media differ from paper-based media (e.g., magazines and newspapers) or traditional electronic media such as TV broadcasting in many ways. Social media and mobile technologies offer new tools for accelerating citizen participation and economic and social progress. Social media is a new type of online media that gives users a lot of room to participate. Social media is the most common blogs, forums, social networks, micro-blog, Wikipedia, podcasts, reviews and content of community. Social customer service that many enterprises are no longer strange, more and more enterprises realize the importance of social media for the brand, is also willing to invest in social media.

The sports venue construction has large investment, high maintenance costs and long payback period. Huge investment and consumption often makes the later running into an unquenchable trap (Anna, Gilbert, Mark, & Ludwig, 2014). In addition to daily teaching activities and sports groups, a large number of idle venues cause a huge waste of resources. The facts show that the venue operation and management have become a worldwide issue. Sports are an important part of sports industry. In general, the old traditional venues have a low rate of utilization, network infrastructure, single profit model and other issues (Yunxia & Fan, 2009). In the wave of the Internet, mobile Internet has penetrated into all aspects of people’s life. In the sports industry, the development of online and offline integration is paid more attention. The combination of technology and venues brings modernization scenarios for the future mass sports venues, such as information, intelligence and data. In the era of big data, venues with the Internet and intelligence represent a general trend. As universities and colleges are the higher institutions to cultivate talents, college intelligent venues are bound to be a new industry ringing in a rapid development.

In intelligent sports venues, due to the popularity of WiFi, mobile 4G and 5G networks, users can apply intelligent devices and APP applications to fulfill automatic ticket admission, fast searching for seats and instant access to the match data (Clemens, Martin, & Roger, 2016). To the ordinary games, users can also get NBA, Europe Champions level broadcast and video editing services. The cameras capture the movement image, such as technical movements and moving, etc, to do technical and health analysis and generate reports. And they also have functions such as screen live in the field, webcast off the field, video replay and downloading; The interaction between inside and outside the fields, automatic ticket admission, wireless company in the whole field, positioning, health analysis and other units may become supporting services in the future venues.

In the era of big data, all the disordered data are filled with the users’ line of sight. In a large number of information, how can users obtain relevant information related to the intelligent venues quickly? Promoting algorithm scientifically and reasonably is an effective method. This paper proposes a new parallel big data promotion algorithm (PBDPA) based on the latest achievements of big data analysis. The proposed algorithm calculates the optimal value by using the observed variables Y, the hidden variable data Z, the joint distribution P(Y,Z|θ) and distribution conditions P(Z|Y,θ). The experimental results show that the proposed algorithm has higher accuracy of big data analysis, and can serve the intelligent sports venues better.

The specific contributions of this paper include:

*   • A literature survey about the present of depth learning, the problem of the sports venue construction, and the new development of social media and mobile technologies, and analyze their advantages and disadvantages.
*   • A new parallel big data promotion algorithm (PBDPA) based on the latest achievements of big data analysis is proposed.
*   • A market operation mode of E-commerce network platform, especially the O2O marketing platform, is proposed to carry on network promotion and management of market information of sports venues.
*   • Performance analysis of the proposed algorithm and an evaluation of the algorithm with respect to other traditional methods.

The rest of this paper is outlined as follows. In Section 2 an overview of related works are presented. Section 3 describes the big data and network promotion. In Section 4, the performance and features of the proposed algorithm are analyzed. Finally, conclusions are presented in Section 5.

2\. RELATED WORKS

In the field of sports industry, the application of social media shows diversity and universality. At present, many international famous venues have fulfilled sports informatization. For example, the teams’ home court venues, such as Germany Dortmund, Holland Ajax, British Glasgow, Australia Gold Coast Sun, has installed WiFi and mobile 4G high-speed network. To meet the users’ demands for the different levels and offer better services and more abundant experience for the fans, the Dortmund stadium decided to innovate the stadium online business model by means of the deployment of wireless networks to realize online gambling, Facebook, Twitter, video playback and other services on demand (Youming, 2009)

The Internet is keeping unprecedented prosperity in the 21st Century. The virtual marketing website has been introduced continuously. So, the researches on the rational utilization and management of stadiums have become more specific. Morteza et al. (2015) designed a proposal of stadium virtual operation and put forward four kinds of modes: (1) the third-party company, led by the stadium virtual operators, cooperates and invest with Sports Bureau and the Ministry of education to conduct marketing operation. (2) The supporting branches, as the state administrative departments, conduct marketing operation. (3) The stadium virtual operators associate with college stadiums to build up economic unions or alliances to carry on marketing development. (4) The stadiums set up joint ventures as professional operations teams. This proposal provides an effective reference of promotion and the use of E-commerce in college stadiums.

In 2010, after studying the factors of restricting the development, Huang Ying clearly pointed out that in fitness clubs, lacking experience and initiative, inputs without immediate benefits and network security to be improved are the four main factors restricting the E-commerce development (Bing & Shuangya, 2009). The rapid development of E-commerce in ten years has brought a large number of network consumers and their online payment habits, which has made a good foundation for the mass sports E-commerce platform. Fan and Chongde (2009) studied the management mode of Nanchang Aviation University stadiums by using the features of campus cards to solve the personnel chaos existing in venue management. The practice proved that the application of campus cards improved utilization of the facilities, and had a practical significance for creating university management mode and external service operations. Researchers have found that the network marketing can bring a variety of benefits for the cooperative operation mode.

The modes of ‘Internet+Sports’ bring users to enjoy innovative view and consuming experience. Based on the Chinese stadiums present, due to the resource scarcity of sports venues and lower utilization, in the new situation of the mobile Internet, the combination of Internet and space resources can improve the informatization and utilization of existing site resources in a certain extent.

By binding the intelligent venues to Alipay, all inquiries, booking, navigation and payment functions are available through the APP operation. By infrared instrument, camera and wireless networks, fitness numbers, fitness time, fitness preferences and other data can be monitored. By collection, statistics and update in the operating system, the fitness in each venue can be clarified (Hongmei, & Serge, 2016). Only with these complete data, it’s more helpful to manage sports departments and let bodybuilders enjoy more convenience by reasonable opening and rich projects based on their interests.

Intelligence sports venues is bound to be improved extraordinarily through VR, AR intelligent technology and WIFI wireless network coverage. Intelligence venues should connect with consumers to enhance the audiences’ match-watching and consumption experience greatly.

*   1\. Stadium informatization: For large stadiums, it’s a necessity to establish construction equipment management system, the sale of the ticket system, intelligent integrated system, public broadcasting system, communication system, information network system, conference system, guidance and information release system, etc. But it’s relatively complex. For the mass fitness venues, convenience, high-quality, comprehensive service are the points of the information service. The construction of WiFi wireless network is the premise and the key point of information services of mass sports venues. On the one hand, the wireless network access provides fast network speed for the users. And by connecting all the people, venues and the terminal screens and deep coupling of network and application, it provides very enjoyable viewing experience for the audience, more effective operation for the venues and sponsors through the jointed digital platform. On the other hand, the off- line venue operator can get the terminal position through the network technology. When the customers are at present, their mobile APP can receive the information push related to the venue marketing, including promotions, exhibition services, event forecasting, etc.
*   2\. Stadium Intelligence: The development of science and technology is a strong backbone for the public stadiums facing for the future and developing modern scene. In the era of mobile Internet, intelligent mobile phone and the rise of the VR/AR equipment will open up all aspects of the industry link. Recently, VR/AR is quite popular and very eye-catching in the WMC2016 related equipment. The VR technology and equipment is one of the main ways of live sports events and interaction in the future. Through the related platforms, the match party offers rich of videos to all the audience in need. In addition, artificial intelligence service, timing system, intelligent lighting system and monitoring system in the off-line stadium have been continuously improved.
*   3\. Data Service: Data is one of more high-end services based on the information and intelligence. On the one hand, the big data of university venues can be analyzed by business WiFi and then carry on essence sale, identifying the behavior preferences in users’ online and offline and classifying them according to these preferences and providing accurate input for the subsequent commercial activities. On the other hand, for the future public venues, health is the major concern. By means of artificial intelligence and big data analysis, the venue operators can get users’ health report and give health guidance for them to increase their attachment to the venues.

3\. DATA ANALYSIS AND GENERALIZATION ALGORITHM

The depth learning method plays an important role in the application and promotion of social media, and has been applied more and more deeply in the O2O platform of stadiums and gymnasiums. Big data analysis refers to the massive data analysis. Data warehouse, data security, data analysis, data mining and other fields focus on the commercial value of big data. With the approach of the big data era, big data analysis has emerged. The front open source tools to big data analysis include JasperSoft, Pentaho, Spagobi, Openi, Birt, etc. The commercial big data analysis tools have Style Intelligence, RapidMiner Radoop, Cognos, BO, Microsoft, Oracle, Microstrategy, QlikView, Tableau.

Whether it is for data analysis experts or ordinary users, data visualization is the most basic requirement in data analysis tools. It can display data intuitively. Cluster, segmentation, outlier analysis and other algorithms are helpful for deepening the data and mining its value. These algorithms not only deal with large amount of the big data, but also its speed. Data mining can make a better understanding for the data analysts, and predictive analysis allows analysts to make some predictive judgment according to the results of visual analysis and data mining. The semantic engine needs to be designed to extract information from the ‘document’ in intelligence, and need a series of tools to resolve, extract and analyze the data. Data quality and data management are the best practice in the aspect of management. Standardized processes and tools for processing the data can ensure the predefined high quality of the analysis results. In the design of business intelligence system, the construction of data warehouse is the key and the foundation of business intelligence system, undertaking the integration of the business system data, providing data extraction, transform and load (ETL) for business intelligence system and having a query and access to the data classified by subjects to set up the data platforms for on-line data analysis and data mining.

In the big data analysis of asynchronous processing, the process of capture, storage and analysis has been complied with. In the process, the data is taken from sensors, web server, terminal sales and mobile device access, and stored in the equipment, and then analyzed. Because these analyses come from traditional Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS), the data formats need to be converted or transformed into structure types which can be used in RDBMS. The process is called extraction, transferring, loading or ETL. The data is extracted from the source system firstly and then standardized and sent to the corresponding data warehouse for further analysis. In a traditional database environment, these ETL steps are relatively direct because the analysis object is often known as the financial report, sales or marketing tables, enterprise resource planning, etc. However, in the big data environment, ETL may become relatively complex, so the processing methods among data source of different types in the transformation process are different. When being analyzed, the data needs be pumped out from the data warehouse at first and put into RDBMS to produce the required report or support the business intelligence applications. In the processing of analyzing the big data, pure data and the converted data are preserved, because they may be transformed again in the later stages.

5\. CONCLUSION

With the development of deep learning technology, the content of personalized reading has been enriched. In the past, machine learning techniques were mainly based on content classification, subject modeling applications, and so on. In the era of big data, constructing venue management platform, sharing fitness service big data, making the perfect combination of the venues and the Internet are the true meaning of the Intelligent Venue. This paper, conforming to the development of E-commerce era, proposes to use market operation mode of E-commerce network platform, especially the O2O marketing platform, to carry on network promotion and management of market information of sports venues, and regards the sports venues as a comprehensive and versatile intelligent sports products, and establishes a network marketing platform with the characteristics of promotion and operation of college sports venues to build a new university of stadiums promotion business model and solve the contradictions between vacancy of university stadiums and shortage of public sports venues. Intelligent venues provide personalized service for users and more colorful viewing experience. Combining with the sports industry and the Internet closely bring infinite possibilities for their own development in the process. The intelligent venues are to boost the development of the whole sports industry inevitably.
